_comment: Expected precision/recall bands for the synthetic AF bank, checked in so a V2 bank-verify run can be
scored against a stated expectation instead of against whatever it happened to produce. A cell landing
outside its band is a FLAG that gets triaged into docs/followups.md -- it is NEVER fixed by widening the
band here. Widening a band is a deliberate, separately-justified edit.
Why these numbers can be demanded at all: golden tier 'high' is peak SNR >= 20, which is 2x the detector's
own default Sensitivity gate (~10). A star the detector misses at 2x its own threshold, on a clean synthetic
frame whose truth is exact, is a genuine recall defect rather than a borderline call. And because synthetic
truth is complete, precision here is an exact measurement, not the lower bound the real bank can only give.

W.description: Wide field, unobstructed, severely oversampled (HFR_min at or under the R2 pixelization floor). Judged on C0@nc2 -- these need no optimizer enrichment.
W._recallRationale: Lower than the M class on purpose: at 0.7px HFR_min the PSF is at the pixelization limit, where centroiding and the MinHFR floor legitimately cost recall.

M.description: Mid focal length, unobstructed, well sampled. The 'well-sampled implies ~everything' anchor.
M._recallRationale: The strictest band in the set. If the detector cannot find 97% of stars at 2x its own gate on a clean, well-sampled synthetic frame, something is wrong that no amount of real-bank noise should have been hiding.

L34.description: Long focal length, 0.34 central obstruction (SCT class). Donut PSFs at the sweep extremes.
L34._configRationale: Judged on config B (donut detection forced on) because C0 is expected to be broken on donut datasets -- that breakage is recorded, not treated as a failure.

L47.description: Long focal length, 0.47 central obstruction (RC/CDK class). The deepest donuts in the bank.

globalBands._configAComment: Config A is the optimizer's own landing with donut detection OFF. On a dataset with no donuts, the optimizer has every opportunity to tune precision, so 0.98 is the floor for it having done so. Donut datasets are exempt because A deliberately withholds the axis they need.
globalBands._afR2Comment: Per-run autofocus fit R^2 on the synthetic hyperbola. The render matches DefocusModel by construction, so anything below 0.95 means the DETECTOR's HFR is not tracking the optical truth -- which is the interesting failure, not a fitting artifact.
globalBands._sensorComment: Aberrations are disabled across the bank, so the sensor-model fit is against a flat field. A low R^2 here is a harness signal, not an optics one.

regressionRule._comment: Applies when comparing two runs on the SAME schema (afbank-verify/3) and the same bank seeds. Any breach is a FLAG for triage, not an automatic failure -- read the per-run notes first.

knownExpectedConditions.condition: C0 (stock defaults, donut detection off) is broken on every donut dataset
knownExpectedConditions.expected: Low recall at the sweep extremes where the PSF is annular. Recorded, not flagged. These datasets are judged on config B.

knownExpectedConditions.condition: D13 must NOT benefit from donut detection
knownExpectedConditions.expected: 1800mm unobstructed: extreme defocus makes filled discs, not annuli. If config B beats config A here by more than noise, donut detection is firing on something that is not a donut -- that is a defect, and it is the reason D13 exists.

knownExpectedConditions.condition: Sparse datasets may legitimately report StarFieldIsExhausted
knownExpectedConditions.expected: 65 and 26 on-frame stars respectively. Exhaustion here is correct behavior, not a flag.
